A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Pulp Motion and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices A–E. Corresponding content can be matched despite pagination changes and additions.

before.justification: v1 reports original dataset-refinement experiments, autoencoder reconstruction results, DiT/MAR generation comparisons, and ablations in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these empirical results and adds DIRECTOR and triplet-plus-Aux comparisons in Tables 4 and 8, alongside a generated-sample density analysis in Figure 25.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix C retain the same joint autoencoder, linear auxiliary mapping, losses, and projected auxiliary-sampling rule. The added triplet-plus-Aux results evaluate another configuration of existing components without documenting a revised algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same PulpMotion full, pure, and mixed subsets and retain HumanML3D's role in refinement and assessment. v2 identifies CondensedMovies as the video source without reporting additional dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: Tables 4 and 8 retain the four original baselines and add (x)+DIRECTOR, which generates camera trajectories conditioned on generated human motion, evaluated with DiT on both subsets. They also add (x,y,z)+Aux as a comparison configuration.

E3.justification: Existing metrics, model sizes, training budgets, and sampling settings remain unchanged. Added evaluations include triplet generation with Aux and a UMAP diagnostic using 2,000 generated samples at auxiliary weights 0, 0.25, and 1.00.

E4.justification: v2 adds triplet-generation comparisons with and without Aux and a density visualization examining how guidance concentrates generated samples (Appendix E.2.6, Figure 25). The existing guidance-weight and modality-independence ablations are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report 95% confidence intervals over 10 samplings in Tables 4, 5, 8, and 9. New result rows follow the existing convention; run-count, seed, and significance-testing information does not change.

E6.justification: Existing table values are retained, while DIRECTOR and triplet-plus-Aux results are added. On the pure subset, the new triplet-plus-Aux configuration obtains FDframing 4.66 for DiT and 4.30 for MAR, below the retained dual-plus-Aux values 5.03 and 4.90. Figure 25 adds a mode-concentration finding. Revised prose also introduces a discrepancy: Appendix E.2.3 says 11.24 where Table 8 retains 10.24.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation, Lemma 3.1, and Appendix C's pseudoinverse definitions, Gaussian independence proof, density decomposition, and sampling derivation are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction retain the same joint-generation, auxiliary-framing, PulpMotion dataset, and architecture-generality contributions. The conclusion preserves these claims and makes the previously identified future direction of finer body-part control more explicit.

C2.justification: v2 interprets the DIRECTOR comparison as evidence that conditioning on generated human motion alone provides insufficient framing context. Appendix E.2.6 newly relates sample concentration to guidance-induced distribution tilting and explicitly acknowledges reduced diversity. The conclusion clarifies the current character-level framing limitation.

D1.justification: Section 4.2 and Appendix D.1 identify CondensedMovies as the source; Section 4.2 additionally specifies filtering, smoothing, and cropping to at most 300 frames. These clarify the existing pipeline rather than establish changed preprocessing. v2 also adds a qualitative-gallery link; architecture, optimization, and hardware details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds Bain et al. (2020) for CondensedMovies and Karras et al. (2024) to contextualize guidance-related distribution concentration. The main related-work discussion and novelty positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Section 5.2 and Appendix E.2.3 expand their results narratives into three findings, with localized revisions to dataset documentation and the conclusion. v2 adds Appendix E.2.6 and a conference-publication header while retaining the overall organization and most prose.

P2.justification: Tables 4 and 8 expand with new rows and revised captions. v2 adds the three-panel UMAP Figure 25 and renumbers the existing captioning example as Figure 26. Several existing figures move with text reflow, but their graphical content is retained.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly strengthens evaluation through the DIRECTOR comparison and triplet-plus-Aux controls, clarifies data provenance, and explicitly examines the coherence–diversity trade-off. Rewritten comparisons better isolate Aux's effects. These gains are tempered by new prose/table inconsistencies, including 11.24 versus 10.24 in Appendix E.2.3 and statements that camera FD increases where the corresponding tables show decreases.
